system.description:
The pilot is the all-important crewman who guides the ship through storm and calm. A good pilot can stay the course through the most terrible gale.

Obstacles: Piloting into a large port, Ob 1. Piloting into a busy port, Ob 2. Piloting into a small, busy port, Ob 3. Piloting through narrow or shallow channels, Ob 4. Piloting through rough or dangerous waters, Ob 5.

FoRKs: Navigation

Skill Type: Seafaring. Tools: No.

Root: Perception/Power

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 288
